support.summary: This is the current coordinated Contract Registry release; Phase 32 defines performance standards, budgets and Contract Portal static evidence, not production Site Runtime telemetry or guaranteed search-ranking outcomes.

recommendedAction: New and changed NEXT F implementations should apply relevant performance rules and budgets, preserve explicit Site version pinning, and collect browser/field evidence for runtime claims. Existing Sites remain pinned until explicit validation and upgrade review.
